chunks: Maybe our Lord will give us better than this. We turn to our Lord in supplication.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when believers say 'We turn to our Lord in supplication' after losing something?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the patience of the faithful during trials, reflecting the spiritual state of longing (raghibun) for divine reward and the certainty of divine substitution (ibdal) for what is sacrificed in His path. It underscores the theological principle that true contentment arises not from retaining worldly possessions but from directing one's desire exclusively toward Allah, a concept deeply resonant with the virtues of the Ahl al-Bayt.
